column2: Ask anything (voice or Telegram), for example "jelaskan kenapa langit biru" (explain why the sky is blue) or "siapa Sultan Hasanuddin?"

small talk gets short answers, questions that need explaining get up to about 6 sentences. When unsure about a fact, the AI first searches Wikipedia (free) and answers from the summary. Zond remembers the last 10 questions and answers until switched off. It still does not know today's news: Google Search for Gemini is only on the paid plan
